# Distribution Packages

## Complete Bundle (Recommended)

- **seo-mcp-skills-v1.0.0.zip** — All 7 skills in one package. Install with `/plugin install` in Claude Code.

| seo-schema-structured-data-v1.0.0.zip | ~24K | JSON-LD, rich results, validation |
| seo-off-page-backlinks-v1.0.0.zip | ~28K | Backlinks, DA, link building, toxic links |
| seo-local-seo-v1.0.0.zip | ~16K | GBP, citations, NAP, reviews |
